Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR PROCUREMENT O F A-GRADE CH ARCOAL 1. Earnest Money Deposit: - (EMD)/Bid Security Every bidder shall deposit an EMD/Bid Security of ₹320 00/- (Rupees Thirty-Two Thousand only) through the mod e prescribed in the GeM Bid, on or before the bid -submission closing date and prior to opening of the bid. P 6 / 12 roof of deposit shall be uploaded with the technical bid . Only those bidders whose EMD has been received and verified within the prescribed period s hall be considered for technical evaluation. However, bidders eligible for EMD exemption under the prevailing GeM GTC/Government rules shall upload valid documentary pro of of such exemption with the b id. Failure to deposit the EMD or upload valid exemption documents within the prescribed period shall r en der the bid liable to rejection. 2. Sample/Quality Verification: - Where submission or evaluation of a sample is permissible under the applicable GeM category an d prevailing GeM provisions, the bidder shall provide a representative sample of the offered Charcoal to the Buyer/ Committee within t he stipulated period. The quality of the entire sup plied material shall be equal to or better than the approved/verified sample and shall strictly conform to th e specifications prescribed in Annexure-A. Approval of the sample shall not relieve the successful seller of r esponsibility for the quality of the entire quantity supplied. 3. Technical Evaluation: - Only those bids that fulfil the EMD requirement or contain valid documentary proof of exemption shall be taken up for technical evaluation. Technical evaluation shall be con ducted by the designated Committee based on the documents uploaded, prescribed specifications, sample/quality ve rification wherever permissible, and other applicable conditions of the GeM Bid. 4. Delivery Period: - The successful bidder shall complete the supply of the entire ordered quantity within 15 days from the date of placement of the GeM Contract/Supply Order. 5. Supply in One Lot: - The entire ordered quantity shall ordinarily be supplied in one complete lot. Part supply or staggered supply shall not be accepted unless specifically permitted in writing by the competent authority under exceptional circumstances. 6. Place of Delivery: - The material shall be delivered at the store/place specified by District Police Line Kishtwar at the seller’s cost and responsibility. The quoted price shall include transportation, freight, loadin g, unloading and all other incidental charges applicable under the GeM Contract. 7. Inspection: - The entire quantity shall be inspected by the designated Inspection/Purchase Committee of District Police Kishtwar a t the time of receipt. The Committee shall have the right to: Inspect the quality and physical condition of the material; Verify conformity with the prescribed specifications; Check the qua ntity and weight ; and Draw samples, wherever required and permissible, for quality verification/testing. 8. Rejection of Substandard Material: - Any material found wet , dusty, inferior, mixed with foreign m atter or otherwise not conforming to the prescribed specifications shall be rejected. The rejected quantity shall not be taken on charge, and no payment shall be admissible for such material. The supplier shall rem ove the rejected material at its own cost and replace it with conforming material within the prescribed deli very period or such extended period as may be permitted by the competent authority. 9. Weighment: - Payment shall be regulated based on the actual net quantity/weight accepted by the co nsignee. Wherever required , weighment shall be conducted through an authorized/approved weighbridge , and the relevant weighment slips shall be produced by the supplier. Any shortage detected during receip t or weighment s hall be deducted from the payable quantity. 10. No Advance Payment: - No advance payment shall be made . Payment shall be processed only after : Complete supply of the ordered material; Inspection and acceptance by the designated Committee/Consi gnee; Verification of quantity and quality; and Submiss ion of the requisite invoice, weighment slips and ot her prescribed documents. 11. Delay in Supply: - Failure to complete the supply within the stipulated delivery period of 15 days shal l attract Liquidated Damages/penalty and other contractual action as prescribed under the prevailing GeM GTC and resultant contract. In case of persistent default or failure to supply, the Buyer may take appropria te contractual action, including cancellation of the contract, strictly in accordance with GeM rules. 12. No Unauthorized Substitution: - The successful seller shall not supply any inferior, substituted or di fferent grade of Coal against the ordered A-Grade Charcoal 13. Compliance with Specifications Submission of the bid shall be treated as confirmation that the bidder h as carefully read, understood and accepted the complete specifications and shall supply the material strict ly in conformity with Annexure-A.

14. Taxes and Duties: - The quoted rates shall be inclusive of all applicable taxes, duties, freight, transp ortation, loading, unloading and other incidental charges applicable under the GeM Contract. 15. Governing Conditions The procurement shall be governed by: GeM General Terms and Conditions; App licable GeM Bid and Category-specific conditions; General Financial Rules, 2017, along with amendments/i nstructions issued from time to time; and administrative approval and specifications conveyed by HQ J&K Police. In case of any conflict between these Buyer Added Terms and mandatory GeM/Government provisio ns, the prevailing mandatory provisions s hall apply. 16. Final Acceptance Final acceptance shall be subject to satisfactory inspection, verification of quantity/w eight and conformity of the supplied Charcoal with the specifications prescribed in Annexure-A. Material n ot conforming to the prescribed specifications shall not b e accepted. 17. Laboratory Testing:- Where considered necessary and permissible under GeM provisions, the Buyer /Inspection Committee may draw samples from the supplied material for testing through a government lab oratory, NABL-accredited laboratory or another authorized laboratory. If the material fails to meet the spec ifications prescribed in Annexure-A, the affected quantity shall be liable to rejection. Testing charges and r eplacement/removal expenses shall be reg ulated in accordance with t he GeM Contract/GTC. 18. Documents to Accompany the Supply: - The successful sell er shall submit the following document s, wherever applicable: Original tax invoice; Delivery challan; Authorized weighbridge slips; E-w ay bill; Tes t/quality certificate; Reference of the GeM Contract/Supply Order; and Any other document required under the GeM Contract. Payment may be withheld until all requisite documents are submitted and verified. 19. Transit Loss or Damage: - The seller shall remain responsible for the material until its delivery, insp ection an d acceptance at the designated destination. Any shortage, deterioration, contamination, wetness , damage or loss during transportation shall be made good by the seller at its own cost. 20. Risk Purchase/Alternative Procurement: - If the successful seller fails to supply the material within the stipulated period or supplies material not conforming to the prescribed specifications, the Buyer may c ancel the contract and procure the material from an alternative source. Recovery of any additional expend iture and other consequential action shall be governed by the prevailing GeM GT C and applicable rules. The Buyer may cancel the bid or resultant contract, wholly or partly , on valid administrative, technical or c ontractual grounds, strictly i n accordance with the prevailing GeM GTC and applicable Government rules. - Sd Sr. Superintendent of Police, Kishtwar . 4.
